business_meaning: Unique identifier of one order (one purchase).
Customer account that placed the order (links to stg_customers).
Current state of the order in its lifecycle.
Sales channel where the order was placed.
Country the order is delivered to.
Total price of the order as invoiced to the customer, VAT and shipping included.
Unique identifier of one payment transaction.
Order this payment pays for (links to stg_orders).
Payment method chosen by the customer.
Amount paid by the customer in this payment, VAT included.
Last 4 digits of the payment card (only for card payments).
Result of the payment transaction: money received, or paid back to the customer.
